pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal patches with high-contrast, relatively sharp edge gradients. Geometric shapes include jagged quadrilaterals and star-like forms with acute interior angles.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light cream-colored pathways. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial. Pixel thickness is narrow and uniform, roughly 1/10th the width of adjacent patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette formed by short, dark, vertical bristles along the upper neck and shoulder line.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Extensive area of brownish textural disruption and hyper-pigmented smudge-like appearance on the upper dorsal ridge, where distinct patch boundaries are obscured.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible localized skin disruption or lesion on the upper-left dorsal region, specifically at the site of oxpecker activity.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two Red-billed oxpeckers (Buphagus erythrorhynchus) interacting with the dorsal skin; significant occlusion by foreground dry vegetation (grass and woody stems).
